props.heading: We make the city hum
props.sub: Indie rock with electronic soul. 50+ live shows across 12 cities. Debut album 'City Hum' out now on vinyl, CD and streaming.

props.label: Our Story
props.heading: Four people, one frequency
props.body:
NEON PULSE formed in the summer of 2022 in a cramped rehearsal room in Bandra, Mumbai. What started as a jam between four friends who met at an open mic night quickly became something none of us expected.

Our sound lives at the intersection of indie rock and electronic music — driving basslines, layered synths, raw guitar riffs and honest lyrics about life in a city that never sleeps. We draw from the energy of Bombay's streets, the introspection of late-night train rides, and the chaos of shared autorickshaw conversations.

In three years we have released twelve singles, one debut album, played over fifty shows across twelve Indian cities, and shared stages with some of the country's most exciting independent acts. Every song we write starts as a loop in someone's bedroom and ends up recorded, mixed and mastered in our own studio.

We are independent, self-produced, and entirely DIY. Every album, every music video, every show is built by us — because that is the only way we know how to make music that feels true.

pillars.title: Original Music
pillars.text: Every song is written, arranged and produced in-house. No ghostwriters, no samples, no shortcuts.

pillars.title: Electric Live Shows
pillars.text: High-energy performances with immersive lighting, visuals and sound that fills the room — every time.

pillars.title: Studio Craft
pillars.text: Our own recording studio means every track gets the time it deserves. No studio clock ticking.

pillars.title: Community First
pillars.text: We run open mics, mentor young artists and believe music is better when it is shared, not hoarded.

props.label: The Band
props.heading: Meet NEON PULSE
props.sub: Four people, one sound. We write, record and perform everything ourselves.

items.name: Aditya 'Neon' Khanna
items.bio: The voice and face of NEON PULSE. Aditya writes most of the lyrics and drives the band's creative direction. Before forming the band, he was a solo acoustic artist playing open mics across Mumbai and Pune.

items.name: Rhea Miranda
items.bio: Rhea brings the riffs, the solos and the harmonies. Trained in both Western classical guitar and Carnatic vocals, her style blends precision with raw energy. She also produces the band's backing tracks.

items.name: Varun Mehta
items.bio: Varun is the low-end and the electronic soul of the band. He handles all studio production, mixing and mastering. His home studio in Bandra is where every NEON PULSE track comes to life.

items.name: Nishant 'Nox' Desai
items.bio: Nishant keeps the rhythm and runs the live show — from setlists to stage lighting to soundcheck. His drumming style blends rock, electronic and Indian folk rhythms into something uniquely ours.

items.name: Zara Sheikh
items.bio: Zara joined in early 2025 and brought a new layer of texture to the band's sound. She plays keys, synthesisers and adds ethereal vocal harmonies that have become a signature of our recent work.

items.title: City Hum — Debut Album
items.desc: Our first full-length album. Ten tracks recorded, mixed and mastered at our Bandra studio. Includes the singles 'Neon Nights', 'Bandra Local' and 'Concrete Jungle'.
items.body:
City Hum is the sound of Mumbai after dark — the rumble of the last local train, the glow of street food stalls, the neon reflections on wet asphalt. Ten tracks that capture the energy, chaos and beauty of life in India's永不 sleeping city.

Recorded over eight months in our Bandra studio, this album represents everything we have learned as musicians and as a band. From the driving rock of 'Neon Nights' to the introspective electronica of '3 AM Worries', every track has been crafted, re-crafted, and then crafted again until it felt right.

The album features collaborations with four guest artists from the Mumbai indie scene and was mastered by Varun Mehta at our in-house studio. The vinyl edition includes a lyric booklet with original artwork by Mumbai-based visual artist Priya Sharma.

items.q: How do I book NEON PULSE for an event?
items.a: Drop us a message through the contact form below, or WhatsApp us directly. Tell us the type of event, expected date, location and your budget range. We usually respond within 24 hours. For festival bookings, please reach out at least 8 weeks in advance.

items.q: What does a typical live set include?
items.a: Our standard set runs 60–90 minutes and includes original material from City Hum and our singles. We also have a selection of curated covers that we can mix in depending on the event type — corporate, college or club. Our setlist is always tailored to the audience and the venue.

items.q: Do you provide your own sound and lighting?
items.a: Yes, we travel with our own sound engineer, backline and a compact lighting rig for venues up to 500 capacity. For larger venues and festivals, we work with your production team. Our technical rider is shared at the time of booking confirmation.

items.q: Can I license your music for my project?
items.a: Yes. We license our music for films, web series, advertisements, podcasts and other media. Sync licensing fees depend on the usage type, territory and duration. Reach out to us with details about your project and we will send a quote.

items.q: Do you offer virtual or remote performances?
items.a: We do offer live-streamed performances for virtual events, product launches and online festivals. These are produced from our studio with multi-camera setup and professional audio. We can also record custom video messages or short acoustic sets.

items.q: Can you write a custom song for my brand or event?
items.a: Absolutely. We have written custom tracks for brands, wedding proposals, anniversary gifts and even a company anthem. The process takes 2–4 weeks from brief to mastered track. Get in touch with your idea and we will take it from there.

props.label: Contact
props.heading: Book NEON PULSE
props.sub:
Ready to book us for your event? Want to collaborate on a track? Or just want to say hi? We read every message and respond within 24 hours.

For urgent booking enquiries, call or WhatsApp us directly.

All bookings are confirmed upon receipt of a 50% advance payment. The remaining balance is due on the day of the performance. Cancellations made more than 30 days before the event date receive a full refund of the advance. Cancellations between 15 and 30 days receive a 50% refund. Cancellations within 15 days forfeit the advance.

Merchandise purchases are non-refundable except in case of manufacturing defects. Defective items must be reported within 7 days of delivery with photographic evidence. Digital downloads are non-refundable once purchased.

NEON PULSE reserves the right to use photographs and video from live performances for promotional purposes unless a written exclusion is requested and agreed upon at the time of booking.

All original music is the intellectual property of NEON PULSE and may not be reproduced, distributed or publicly performed without written permission, except as permitted under fair use provisions of Indian copyright law.

Set times, band line-up and technical requirements are finalised at least two weeks before the event date and are subject to change only in case of medical emergencies or circumstances beyond the band's control.
